Any file can be picked. Text files whose lines are engine arguments are inlined as a launch config; everything else is appended as -file <path>. Files that are not reachable through a plain path are copied into mods/ first.
Launch arguments applied from the file.
Turns off SDL joystick handling entirely (+use_joystick 0). Use this when the menu scrolls on its own: that is a device reporting a stuck axis. Keyboard and mouse are unaffected.

Drag to look, tap to fire, two fingers to scroll, and the finger is a pointer while a menu is open. Look sensitivity is in the game: Options → Touch controls. Off hands the pointer back to SDL's touch-to-mouse translation, which is only useful for debugging.
Off starts the engine with -nosound. If the app dies on start-up, turning this off is the quickest way to tell whether the audio library is involved.
No log yet - start the engine once.
Delete the engine configuration file? Settings, key bindings and the renderer choice will go back to their defaults.
